objects: overhead white car tilted in creek
actions: car rotates and slides leftward across the creek, ending partly cut off at left edge by 15.8 s
wake lines trail behind the car
text: In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
observed: Frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. The white car tilts diagonally in the creek and moves left and rotates, foam piled at its front, wake streaks trailing, until it is partly out of frame at left. Water has pale ripple lines, banks have round bushes. Caption unchanged. Lower area is green bank.
